Permit portal is the County ePermits Center. No dedicated ADU page found; Planning page links an ADU Permit PDF (https://www.claytonca.gov/DocumentCenter/View/187/Accessory-Dwelling-Unit-Permit-PDF). City Hall: (925) 673-7300.

jurisdictions.name: Contra Costa County (unincorporated)
jurisdictions.notes: Department of Conservation and Development (DCD), Building Inspection Division, 30 Muir Road, Martinez. Phone is the Building Inspection 'Main' line in the County directory. The Application and Permit Center (building and planning) is (925) 655-2700; inspection scheduling is (925) 646-4108. building_dept_url is the page the directory links as the Building Inspection services page; permit overview: https://www.contracosta.ca.gov/7947/Permit-information. The County also provides building permit and inspection services for Clayton, Hercules, Lafayette, Moraga, and Orinda. parcel_lookup_url is CCMAP, which redirects to an ArcGIS Experience 'Parcel Viewer' (https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/caa59504ea0040cfac8ea0b11393c486). It searches by address or APN; its web map includes a 'City Boundaries' layer plus General Plan and Zoning layers (zoning and general plan cover unincorporated areas only). The County page (https://www.contracosta.ca.gov/4843/Property-Zoning-Lookup) does not describe it as a city-or-unincorporated lookup.
